_comment: CAS numbers for rows the source sheet left blank or wrote as #VALUE!. Keyed by product id. A string sets one CAS; a list of {label, cas} declares a product sold in multiple isomeric forms. Every CAS is validated against the official check-digit algorithm before it is emitted.
_provenance: Each verified against multiple independent references (ChemicalBook, Sigma-Aldrich, PubChem, USP, TCI, Cayman Chemical) in August 2026.
